hook: *66%* of India's road deaths are people aged 18-34
hook_b: *66%* of India's road deaths are people aged 18-34
tldr: Opening the 85th Indian Roads Congress session in Hyderabad, Union minister Nitin Gadkari called for zero road deaths and said 66% of those killed are aged 18-34. He assured support for Telangana Rising Vision 2047 but announced no specific project approvals.

beats.what: Gadkari opened the four-day 85th IRC session in Hyderabad and called for zero road deaths.
beats.why: India loses about 1.8 lakh lives on roads a year, mostly young people.
beats.care: He asked engineers to remove accident black spots through error-free project reports.

event.label: Gadkari calls for zero deaths at IRC
